notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. 930-006_ClawAxle.scad draws it and gives its features: it is #930-006 run on along y, and it serves both pivots in the same way. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
